title: Charing Cross

buildingCutout.basis: One mapped polygon represents the statue pedestal. The pedestrian island and nearby buildings stay native.

note: The current monument marks the Charing Cross catalog location. The medieval Eleanor Cross and the Victorian memorial outside the railway station are separate structures. The bronze pose and Portland stone carving are photo-based reconstructions. Fine lettering and heraldic devices are simplified. The native pedestrian island and roads remain visible. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.
